summary: Frontend testing of new Cosmic Runner features: (1) Power-ups with shiny/sparkly visuals, (2) Bullpug orientation flipped to face down lane, (3) Dynamic moving background with nebulas and stage-based themes. All features verified working correctly through visual testing and code review.
passed_tests: Power-up configuration - POWERUP_TYPES defines Shield (Guardian Shield), Magnet (Mooncake Magnet), DoubleScore (Star Power)
Power-up duration - all set to 10000ms (10 seconds) as specified
Power-up spawn interval - POWERUP_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 720 frames (12 seconds at 60fps)
Power-up visuals - rendering includes: outer sparkle aura, 8-pointed sparkle rays, main orb with gradient, inner icon, highlight shine, orbiting sparkles (lines 1173-1252)
Power-up collection - activates for 10 seconds with HUD indicator showing icon and countdown timer (lines 1468-1496)
Shield power-up - absorbs one hit from obstacle and removes it (lines 598-617)
Magnet power-up - attracts mooncakes towards player lane with gradual lane movement (lines 484-493)
DoubleScore power-up - applies 2x multiplier to mooncake score (line 651-652)
Shield visual effect - pulsing cyan ring around player when active (lines 1498-1512)
Bullpug orientation - ctx.scale(-1, 1) flips sprite horizontally to face down the lane (line 1333)
Dynamic background - stars array with parallax movement based on speed and depth (lines 205-212, 511-518)
Dynamic background - nebulas array moving with parallax (lines 213-221, 521-528, 751-763)
Dynamic background - cosmic objects (galaxies/planets) moving slowly (lines 223-231, 530-538, 719-748)
Stage-based themes - STAGE_BACKGROUNDS with 5 stages: Deep Space (blue 240), Blue Nebula (cyan 200), Purple Galaxy (purple 280), Cosmic Fire (orange 20), Multiverse (rainbow -1)
Background hue transitions - smoothly transitions to stage hue or rainbow effect for stage 5 (lines 542-550)
Mobile controls - touch event handlers for swipe detection (lines 1592-1660)
Mobile controls - swipe left/right for lane change with minSwipeDistance=30 and maxSwipeTime=500ms
Mobile controls - swipe up for jump
Mobile controls - tap zones: left third = left lane, right third = right lane, center = jump (lines 1645-1657)
Mobile hint - displays 'Swipe ← → to change lanes | Swipe ↑ or Tap center to jump' on touch devices (line 1533)
Game canvas renders correctly on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports
Score, mooncakes, stage indicator displayed correctly in HUD
context_for_next_testing_agent: Power-ups feature verified: spawns every 720 frames (12 sec), 3 types (shield/magnet/doubleScore), 10 sec duration, shiny rendering with sparkles at lines 1173-1252, HUD indicator at lines 1468-1496. Bullpug flipped with ctx.scale(-1,1) at line 1333 to face down lane. Dynamic background: stars (205-212), nebulas (213-221), cosmic objects (223-231) with parallax movement. Stage themes at STAGE_BACKGROUNDS (lines 68-74). Mobile touch controls at lines 1592-1660 with swipe and tap zones.
